verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents branch or tag protection rules, required approving reviews, or required status checks before merge. It covers only adjacent features: pull-request code review, Gitea Actions CI, and general permission management/ACLs. None of these is the protection-rule capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can protect branches and tags with rules requiring reviews and passing checks before merge
